title: Great!
text: Great!. I have been having fun organizing my pantry with these clear storage bins. These are durable and sturdy. Since they're clear, it's easy to see what's inside them. I like having everything look uniform and this is an improvement from the mismatched baskets I was using.

product_metadata.title: ESARORA Plastic Storage Bin with Lid and Divider, Clear Shallow Pantry Organizer with Handle for Fridge, Cabinet, Kitchen, Bedroom, Closet, Bathroom, Office, Pantry Organization,10 Pack 10.28 inch
features: 【Set of 10】This set is come with 10 pack same size fridge organizer bins with lid and divider. Each bin measures Approx. 10.28*6*3 inch.

【Superior Quality】ESARORA pantry storage bins made of durable high quality 100% food safe, BPA free and shatter-resistance plastic. Clear design can see what’s inside at glance. DO NOT PLACE IN DISHWASHER. Please clean with hands using mild detergent and water (temperature range -20 degree to 50 degree).

【Removable Dividers】There have one removable divider in each food storage organizer bin, making it easy to separate and organize your items. They are perfect for organizing spice packets, gravy packets, seasoning packets, tea packets, instant food packets, and other packets.

【Stackable Design】This refrigerator organizer bins designed with practical carry handles and lids. Lids can protect the contents of orgianizer bins from crushed, prevent moisture and dust for keeping fresh; Also can effectively prevent foods with strong flavours and smells from tainting other food in fridge. Stackable with lids can save your space and bring more convenience to you.

【Functional & Versatile】Our plastic pantry storage racks can ideal for fruits, vegetables yogurts, canned goods, food packets, cheese, meat, dry goods etc; Also perfect for cabinet and pantry shelves, craft rooms, laundry or utility rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, offices, garages and nurseries; Versatile, lightweight and easy to transport, it works great in apartments, condos, dorm rooms, RVs, cabins and campers.
